# Misc / runtime knobs

One line per setting: NAME — default — meaning. Code anchors and full prose:
`docs/CONFIGURATION.md`. Index: `references/configuration.md`.

- DATA_PERMS_MAX_ENTRIES — default: 200000 — entry budget for the data-home permission walk (`polyrob doctor --perms`, the status `security` line); over it the report says `truncated` and names the budget — "no offenders in the first N" is not "no offenders".
- POLYROB_ALLOW_ROOT_CLI — default: OFF (false) — let a root-run owner CLI verb WRITE the deployed data home (script escape hatch; `--as-root` is the interactive one).
- TWITTER_REQUIRE_APPROVAL — default: ON ('true') — Ask the owner once more before an X write on a genuine owner turn (OFF = the owner's request is the approval).
- TWITTER_POST_COOLDOWN_ENABLED — default: **ON** — 2026-08-28: durable, cross-session minimum gap between AUTONOMOUS `twitter_post`/`twitter_thread` writes (a repeat goal re-firing in a fresh session, each with its own fresh in-memory rate-limit bucket, posted 30+ near-duplicate tweets ove…
- TWITTER_POST_COOLDOWN_SEC — default: 3600 — Minimum seconds between two autonomous `twitter_post`/`twitter_thread` writes for the same tenant, enforced by `TWITTER_POST_COOLDOWN_ENABLED`.
- X_BROWSER_ENABLED — default: OFF — Register the captured-session `x_browser` tool for visible-inbox reads, existing-thread DM sends, posting, and self-registration.
- X_SIGNUP_HANDLE — default: unset (= the instance id) — The @handle `x_signup_start` REQUESTS for the agent's own X account (sanitised to letters/digits/underscore, ≤15 chars).
- X_SIGNUP_DISCLOSURE — default: unset (= Automated account: <instance> is an autonomous POLYROB agent. Posts are generated by software.) — The automation-disclosure bio the signup writes to the new X profile (≤160 chars).
- ALLOWED_REASONING_TURNS — default: 1 — Tool-free planning turns allowed before escalation.
- COMPACTION_COOLDOWN_STEPS — default: 8 — Minimum steps between LLM-compaction firings in the 85–95 % band.
- COMPACTION_PROMPT_GUARD — default: **ON** — Anti-injection framing on the compaction summarizer prompt + rebuilt summary.
- COMPACTION_CHECKPOINT — default: ON ('true') — Dump pre-compaction trajectory.
- MAX_REPETITIONS — default: 2 (dev) / 3 (prod) — Loop-detection repeat threshold.
- UNCHANGED_STATE_THRESHOLD — default: 3 (dev) / 4 (prod) — Unchanged-state loop threshold.
- EMPTY_ACTION_FAST_ESCALATE — default: ON ('true') — Escalate fast on empty-action loops.
- MIN_STEPS_BEFORE_DONE — default: 3 — Minimum steps before `done()` is honored.
- STEP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS — default: 300 — Per-step timeout.
- STALL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS — default: 300 — Stall detection.
- LLM_BASE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS — default: 30 — Base LLM timeout (adjusted up by token count).
- LLM_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS — default: 120 — Standard LLM request timeout.
- LLM_STREAM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS — default: 300 — Streaming LLM timeout.
- SHELL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS — default: 630 — Per-action timeout for a `shell` tool call.
- CODE_EXEC_TIMEOUT_SECONDS — default: 630 — Per-action timeout for a `code_execution` AND a `coding` tool call (`coding.run_tests` runs on the same backend with the same ceiling; under the 60 s default it was killed first); above the tool's own ceiling for the same reason as `SHELL_…
- DEFAULT_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS — default: 180 — Per-action timeout for every tool without its own entry. `defi_data`'s pricing budget (`DEFI_PORTFOLIO_PRICE_BUDGET_SEC`) must stay below it.
- MAX_PARSE_RETRIES — default: 3 — JSON-from-text parse retries (fallback path).
- ENABLE_ROBUST_PARSE — default: ON — Master switch for the robust JSON-from-text parse machinery (retries + template hints on the non-native-tools path).
- ENABLE_JSON_TEMPLATE_RETRY — default: ON — On a parse failure, retry with an explicit JSON-template hint (bounded by `MAX_PARSE_RETRIES`).
- ENABLE_CONTEXT_OVERFLOW_GUARD — default: ON — Abort a step whose estimated tokens exceed `CONTEXT_OVERFLOW_THRESHOLD` of the model's context window.
- REQUIRE_SCHEMA_KEYS — default: OFF — Strict JSON-candidate validation: require `current_state`+`action` keys before accepting a parsed candidate.
- INJECT_FORMAT_HINT_EARLY — default: ON — Inject the JSON format hint proactively on the non-native-tools path (instead of only after a failure).
- FORCE_RECALIBRATE_AFTER_LARGE_ACTIONS — default: ON — Force a token-count recalibration after an action result over `LARGE_ACTION_THRESHOLD` chars.
- STRIP_BASE64_IMAGES — default: true — Strip `data:image/...;base64,` blobs from parsed page content (`false` disables).
- TOOL_RESULT_AGE_CHARS — default: 2000 — At a compaction boundary — and ONLY there, which is already a cold prefix — every `ToolMessage` outside the protected tail (the newest 6) longer than this is demoted to its first line plus a NAMED pointer: the `read_file(file_path=…)` line…
- MEDIA_KEEP_MAX — default: 6 — Image-bearing turns the conversation may hold before ANY is retired.
- MEDIA_RETIRE_BATCH — default: 4 — Image turns whose base64 is retired in ONE step once `MEDIA_KEEP_MAX` is passed (the pass always retires at least enough to land back at the ceiling, so a second pass is a no-op).
- MEDIA_KEEP_FLOOR — default: 2 — Newest image turns never retired, whatever the count — vision continuity for the current turn.
- STORE_LARGE_CONTENT_AS_FILES / MAX_EXTRACTED_CONTENT_LENGTH — default: ON / 500000 — Consulted only by the legacy `should_store_content_as_file` helper (test-pinned; no production caller today — the live offload path keys on `MAX_EXTRACTED_CONTENT_SIZE` above).
- TASK_MODE — default: BALANCED — Task agent mode preset.
- TASK_PERSONALITY_BLOCK — default: ON under POLYROB_LOCAL, OFF on the server — Inject the `<identity>` persona block into the task agent.
- ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY — default: OFF (false) — Opt-in anonymized PostHog product analytics (never on by default).
- VALIDATE_OUTPUT — default: OFF — Judge-backed validation of the agent's final answer before it's accepted (wired through the lazily provisioned auxiliary judge model and fail-open to the main model).
- INTERRUPT_REDIRECT — default: OFF — Ctrl-C mid-turn prompts for a redirect instruction that becomes the next turn instead of silently aborting.
- POLYROB_ENV — default: development (falls back to ENVIRONMENT) — Deployment environment name; `production`/`prod` makes the MCP encryption layer require a real `MCP_ENCRYPTION_KEY` instead of the dev key file.
- POLYROB_HOME — default: ~/.polyrob — Override for the polyrob home directory (CLI config, keys, home-migration target).
- POLYROB_PROFILE — default: unset — Named-profile selection (tier 2; the `-P`/`--profile` flag is tier 1 and overwrites it).
- POLYROB_PROFILE_SOURCE — default: env — Internal hand-off, set by `activate_profile` for child processes: records WHICH tier (flag/pin/sticky/env) selected the active profile so children report the original source.
- POLYROB_PROFILES_ROOT — default: polyrob_home()/profiles — Location of the profile registry + parent of the sticky file.
- POLYROB_ALLOW_CROSS_PROFILE — default: OFF — Opt-in bypass of the cross-profile file guard: with it OFF, the filesystem/coding tools refuse to touch ANOTHER profile's home (defense-in-depth, not a security boundary).
- POLYROB_BIN_DIR — default: ~/.local/bin — Where `polyrob profile create/alias` writes per-profile wrapper commands (`<name>` → `polyrob -P <name>`).
- PERSONALITY_DEFAULT_CHARACTER — default: polyrob — Which `<name>.character.json` renders the default persona.
- POLYROB_IN_DOCKER — default: unset — Force the self-update detector to classify the install as Docker (normally auto-detected via `/.dockerenv`); updates then mean "rebuild the image".
- POLYROB_NONINTERACTIVE — default: unset — Truthy ⇒ never prompt interactively (suppresses the inline API-key wizard; same effect as `CI=true`).
- POLYROB_PERSONA — default: unset — Persona for the CLI agent's `<identity>`: a known template key renders that template's persona (and seeds its skills); any other non-empty value is used as literal free-form persona text.
- POLYROB_PLAIN — default: OFF — Force the plain (non-Rich) CLI renderer; mirrors `--plain` (the flag wins).
- POLYROB_WORKSPACE_LOCK_DIR — default: set by bootstrap — Directory for the CLI workspace lock (interactive-gate/CWD-corruption guard).
- TASK_MAX_MESSAGES — default: unset (= model-derived) — Explicit override of MessageManager's max-message window; non-numeric values are ignored with a WARN.
- CONFIDENCE_CHECK_BEFORE_DONE — default: ON — BALANCED-mode preset: run the confidence check before honoring `done()`.
- TASK_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED — default: ON — BALANCED-mode preset: require task verification before completion.
- HISTORY_SECRET_SCRUB — default: ON — Pattern-based secret scrub (conservative shapes only) over message history, even with no sensitive-data allowlist registered; `off` restores allowlist-only.
- SOURCE_PRECEDENCE_PROMPT — default: ON — Separate instruction authority from factual freshness: system/runtime policy applies; the latest genuine owner/user instruction can revise the pinned task; tool results and memory remain data.
- AUTO_AGENT_INIT — default: OFF — Run the task-agent module initializer at import instead of lazily.
- PROFILE_MEM — default: unset (1 enables) — Dev: register an atexit memory-profile dump for the agent process (tracemalloc-based).
- BROWSER_USE_LOGGING_LEVEL — default: info — `debug` turns on verbose telemetry-service debug logging.
- POSTHOG_API_KEY — default: phx_dev_fallback_key (secret, masked) — PostHog project key for anonymized telemetry (rides `ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY`); the checked-in default is a non-functional dev placeholder.
- TELEMETRY_FEED_MAX_FILES — default: 200 — Max feed files kept per session by feed retention.
- TELEMETRY_FEED_MAX_AGE_HOURS — default: 168 (7 days) — Max age of kept feed files.
- TELEMETRY_FEED_RETENTION_EVERY — default: 50 — Run feed retention every N feed writes (min 1).
- LAZY_DEPS_MODE — default: trusted — how `core.lazy_deps.ensure` installs an ALLOWLISTED optional extra on first use (a Gemini turn installs the Gemini SDK; a PDF read installs `[docs]`). `trusted` = the feature's shipped, HASHED closure (`core/lazy_closures/<feature>.txt`, g…
- POLYROB_PACKS — default: unset — comma list of the pack ids that load (the `polyrob.packs` entry points).
- POLYROB_PACKS_DISABLED — default: unset — comma list of pack ids that never load, even when named in `POLYROB_PACKS` (disabled wins).
- POLYROB_BOOTSTRAP_STAGES — default: unset — **Set by `install.sh`, not by you.** A JSON object (`install_method`, `source_dir`, `venv_dir`, `command`, `stages[]`) that the installer hands to `polyrob setup` so ONE writer records the install in `<config home>/.polyrob-bootstrap.json`.
- TELEMETRY_EVENT_LOG_ENABLED — default: ON — The durable telemetry event log (`telemetry_events.db`) — additive observability sink, fail-open; `off` disables.
- TELEMETRY_EVENT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS — default: 30 (min 1) — Prune event-log rows older than this on the heartbeat ticker.
- EXTERNAL_WRITE_TELEMETRY — default: ON — record one `external_write` row per outward act — classified `social`/`comms`/`public`/`money`/`code`/`self`/`network` by `core/effects.py` at the Controller post-hook, the two `MessageRouter` sends and the no-Controller writers (cron deli…
- EXTERNAL_WRITE_PAUSE_GATE — default: ON — the Controller effect pre-hook refuses an AUTONOMOUS or forged `social`/`comms`/`public`/`money` write while the matching owner pause covers it (`social_post`, `outbound_comms`, `oversight_deploy` / `app_deploy`, `spend`), and records the…
- EXTERNAL_WRITE_STRICT — default: OFF — refuse a write verb that has no explicit row in `core/effects.py` (`WRITE_ACTIONS`/`NON_WRITE_ACTIONS`) instead of recording it at the tool's ceiling with `confidence=tool`.
- TWITTER_API_KEY / TWITTER_API_SECRET_KEY / TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN / TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET — default: unset (secret, masked) — OAuth 1.0a user-context credentials for the twitter tool, the X DM surface, and `polyrob avatar push --twitter`; explicit creds passed to the client win over env.
- TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN — default: unset — **SECRET, masked** — X API app bearer token.
- TWITTER_OAUTH2_ACCESS_TOKEN — default: unset (secret, masked) — OAuth 2.0 PKCE **user** access token with `dm.read`, `users.read`, and `tweet.read` (plus `dm.write` when sending).
- TWITTER_OAUTH2_REFRESH_TOKEN — default: unset (secret, masked) — The OAuth 2.0 **refresh** token that pairs with `TWITTER_OAUTH2_ACCESS_TOKEN` (issued only when the grant asked for `offline.access`).
- TWITTER_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID — default: unset — The X app's OAuth 2.0 **Client ID** (developer.x.com → app → Keys and tokens).
- TWITTER_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET — default: unset (secret, masked) — The app's OAuth 2.0 **Client Secret**, needed only for a *confidential* app (X then wants HTTP Basic on the token endpoint).
- X_OAUTH2_REDIRECT_URI — default: unset — The console URL X redirects the owner's browser to after `/x login` — exactly `https://<console host>/api/packs/x/oauth/callback` (http only for 127.0.0.1/localhost), and registered as a callback URI of the X app (developer.x.com → app → U…
- TWITTER_CHAT_PASSPHRASE — default: unset (secret, masked) — X Chat secure-key-backup passphrase/PIN.
- TWITTER_CHAT_PRIVATE_KEYS_B64 — default: unset (secret, masked) — Alternative server/bot X Chat private-key blob exported by Chat XDK.
- TWITTER_CHAT_KEY_VERSION — default: unset (auto from X public-key record) — Registered public-key version paired with `TWITTER_CHAT_PRIVATE_KEYS_B64`.
